answer: Each agent can be registered only after posting a bond that is locked while it participates in the economy and slashed if independent audits expose fabricated identities or collusive claims. The bond makes a sybil attack costly: an attacker must tie up real capital for every fake account, and detection destroys some of it. Audits can sample transactions around a disputed vertex, compare each account’s delta in behavior over time, and intensify checks after a gale of near-identical registrations appears.
